Hi Lucy — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you up and running in the next two weeks: 

1) Procurement path decision: you mentioned procurement prefers PO. Can you confirm whether AstraHealth will route via a central vendor portal (preferred) or need direct vendor onboarding (banking + W-9). If PO, please confirm Net terms (Net 30 / Net 45) and the contact in AP who will approve the PO.

2) Marketplace option: we have AWS Marketplace and direct invoicing. Marketplace speeds procurement for some customers but can add a month of billing lag depending on your AP flows. Would you like us to include marketplace as an option?

3) Vendor intake forms: attaching our vendor setup packet (PDF) — it includes the W-9/W-8 guidance and the bank wiring stub. If you prefer to fill AstraHealth's intake form instead, send that back and we’ll populate our side.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_setup_packet_v1.pdf (vendor packet, W-9 guidance, banking stub)

Next steps: reply with which payment path you prefer (PO via portal / PO direct / card / marketplace), confirm AP contact + email, and attach any intake forms your team requires. If you're ready, Monica (cc'd) will lead the portal onboarding.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this over the finish line.

—Markus

Thanks for the ping — quick finance / ops checklist and recommended path: 

1) Coupa onboarding: good route. We have completed Coupa vendor setups before; typical turnaround once the intake form is submitted and validated is 5–10 business days. To speed things up we should send their AP contact a pre-filled vendor packet with our TIN and bank stub.

2) Required docs: since AstraHealth is US-based we need a completed W-9 from our side (we will attach our standard W-9 template) and their signed intake form. No W-8 needed in this case.

3) Payment methods: Finance confirms Redwood can accept PO (Net 30) for this account. If they ask for an initial trial faster than onboarding allows, we can provide a credit-card based invoice for the first month; Finance will flag that as a short-term exception.

4) Who owns next steps: Monica will own the portal onboarding. Action items below: 
   - Monica: pre-fill redwood_vendor_setup_packet_v1.pdf with TIN + bank stub and upload to Coupa portal once AstraHealth confirms the portal URL or invites us. (attachment: vendor_packet_filled.pdf, W-9_Template.pdf)
   - Markus: send the MSA draft link so legal can sign in parallel (DocuSign link below).
   - Ben: coordinate billing codes (product SKUs) and expected monthly spend for PO line items.
